name: @semiont/tests-conformance
description: Black-box conformance suites for the gateway, the dispatcher, the Archivist, the Worker service, the Weaver, the Smelter, the Librarian and the SDKs: they start the processes and check them against specs/. They import nothing from any implementation: the Weaver suite reads and changes the graph by its own Cypher and its own reading of a row, and the Smelter suite reads and changes the vector index by its own calls to Qdrant. See README.md.

scripts.pretest: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:smelter && npm run typecheck:librarian
scripts.test:gateway: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project gateway
scripts.test:dispatcher: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project dispatcher
scripts.test:archivist: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project archivist
scripts.test:sdk: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project sdk
scripts.test:worker: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project worker
scripts.test:worker-service: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project worker-service
scripts.test:weaver: npm run typecheck && vitest run --project weaver
scripts.test:smelter: npm run typecheck:smelter && vitest run --project smelter
scripts.test:librarian: npm run typecheck:librarian && vitest run --project librarian
